description: This file defines an EmployeePictureService class responsible for managing employee pictures in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, resizing, and caching employee picture data, as well as handling ETag caching for optimization.

classes.name: EmployeePictureService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee picture retrieval, storage, resizing, and caching.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeePictureDao instance.

methods.name: pictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Adjusts the size of a picture to fit within 200x200 pixels, maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Saves an employee picture to the database.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture by their employee number.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture only if the current user has access rights or is viewing their own.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for an employee's picture, using cache if available.

methods.name: deleteEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes cached ETag for an employee's picture.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and caches an ETag for an employee picture.

methods.name: generateEmpPictureETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key to store ETag for an employee picture.
